landmarks.name: Corniche Mosque, source-registered T22 shoreline
landmarks.source: Corniche Mosque at retained OSM node608700976 is72.7m from native4195.8m, on the right approaching T22. Direct supplied279/668s forward views show the pale domed mosque and minaret beside the central stand. F1's primary2021 site visit also places a mosque atT22. Aga Khan/Archnet DTP101639 gives195m² floor area and1200m² site, with a domed square hall, east mihrab/oculus, northern vaulted porch, western two-shallow-dome loggia and southern minaret. Faisal Al-Abdullah's original2013 exterior photo separately establishes a round white shaft, solid faceted balcony, arched lantern/crown, crescent finials and small pyramidal roof-corner caps. Square shafts/wooden lattice balconies pictured for other mosques in the multi-project report are not transferred to Corniche. Model dimensions approximate that published floor area; hall10m, roof9.8m and minaret19.0m are architectural estimates, approximately±20% in plan and±3m in height. Label-point registration is estimated±15m, not a traced footprint. The exposed porch/arcade and exterior silhouette are modeled without invented hidden rooms. Existing field is retained outside the finite occupied floor/plinth; no site flattening, road/physics/native data or new materials. Sparse old335/640 sector associations and rear-camera271/275 are not used to place this family. The minaret stands at the southern end of the western loggia, estimated local centre(-7.25,-6.4)m, matching the clear right-of-dome separation in supplied668. Its top19.0m above floor including finial is an architectural estimate ±3m, informed by the source668 apparent tower/dome ratio about1.78 and the taller shaft/crown in the original2013 photo; it is not a survey or exact pixel-to-height conversion. The source279 tower is cropped and is not used for complete height measurement. The hall remains9.8m above floor. Floor3.8m is a local architectural datum estimate, approximately±0.6m, above the actual retained2.65–3.64m perimeter Ground. Existing dune/field planes outside the occupied podium remain unchanged.
